content:
Date: 2026-03-25
Owner: Leo Williams (CS)

Purpose: Day-of scratchpad for account reminders  QBR prep, renewal outreach, and open support follow-ups. Quick bullets, actions, and talking points.

TODAY'S PRIORITIES (top of day):
- Finalize slide deck for AcmeCorp QBR (9:00 AM delivery to Execs). Need final numbers from finance (ARR impact) + product roadmap slide. (Action: Maria to confirm ARR line item by 2pm).
- Renewal outreach for BrightBank (renewal window: 2026-04-10). Confirm legal has latest addendum and pricing. (Action: Daniel to loop legal).
- Escalate support ticket #CS-1124 blocking Milestone B for NovaTech (customer waiting on rate-limit increase). Need SRE ETA.

QBR  AcmeCorp (2026-03-27, 10:00 PST)
- Slides to include: 1) Exec summary (health + ask), 2) Usage trends (tokens/day, p95 latency), 3) Cost optimization suggestions (batching, quantization), 4) Roadmap alignment (private deployment timeline), 5) Risks + mitigation (capacity constraints).
- Data sources: billing-report-MAR2026 (ask finance), infra-telemetry p95/99 (ask observability).
- Talking points draft: "Since last QBR, we've improved p95 latency from 210ms to 150ms after kernel optimizations; recommended next step: pilot x1 dedicated pool for high-throughput inference to reduce unit cost by ~18%."
- Open items: Product slide for private deployment timeline (Priya to provide latest ETA by EOD).
- Action list:
  - Leo: merge slides + run rehearsal with Maria (tomorrow 9:30am).
  - Maria: ARR/usage numbers (due 2pm 3/25).
  - Priya: private deployment ETA + compatibility notes (due EOD 3/25).

RENEWALS
- BrightBank (Primary contact: Emma Cole / AE: Daniel Park)  renewal 2026-04-10.
  - Current ARR: $180k/year. Opportunity to upsell to Dedicated for compliance use-case (estimated +$45k).
  - Risks: legal needs new addendum; procurement timeline may slip if pricing not approved.
  - Next steps: Daniel to confirm legal draft and pricing; Leo to schedule renewal review call week of 3/30.
- SkylineMedia  auto-renew in 6 weeks. Low usage, health score=yellow. Set up 1:1 to review usage + new recommendations. (Action: send usage summary by 3/28).

SUPPORT FOLLOW-UPS (tickets)
- CS-1124 (NovaTech)  rate-limit increase request; SRE assigned: Arun. Current status: awaiting capacity confirmation. Impact: blocking M1 milestone.
  - Notes: customer frustrated  prioritize. Escalation: ping @arun-sre in Slack and cc Priya. Target: resolve by 3/26 EOD.
- CS-1178 (AcmeCorp)  structured output formatting bug causing malformed JSON on function call. Engineering PR exists (#486). Need QA signoff. Owner: Priya.

MEETING NOTES / Talking points for quick calls
- Quick reminder for Acme QBR: "We want alignment on pilot scope and a go/no-go decision for Q2 dedicated capacity by end of QBR."
- For BrightBank renewal: "We can offer a 6-month phased migration to Dedicated with a capped overage policy to reduce procurement risk."

REMINDERS / TODOs
- Follow up with SRE for CS-1124 (urgent)  Leo (ASAP)
- Build 1-page one-pager for Dedicated pilot benefits (use cost delta chart)  Maria (3/27)
- Draft renewal proposal email for BrightBank to send after legal confirms pricing  Leo (once legal confirms)
- Prep demo environment for AcmeCorp walkthrough (test prompt set + latency script)  Eng-led; include runbook link in slides

NOTES TO SELF (informal)
- Keep slide deck concise  execs only care about 3 things: health, ask, ROI.
- If finance misses ARR numbers by 2pm: pull approximate numbers from billing-report-MAR2026 and flag as provisional.
- If SRE ETA slips >24h, propose temporary quota bump from dedicated buffer.

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS
- Will product commit to private deployment GA timeline before the end of Q2? (Priya asked product; awaiting confirmation)
- Can sales/legal expedite BrightBank pricing approval? Who owns PO chase? (Confirm with Daniel)

QUICK LINKS (for slides / handoff)
- QBR slides draft: drive link (add final to Confluence after review)
- Metrics dashboard: /dashboards/account-health/AcmeCorp
- Support tickets: JIRA board CS-queue

END OF DAY CHECKLIST
- [ ] Slides submitted to execs
- [ ] Renewal check-in scheduled with BrightBank
